title: Security Sync — Playbook Review & Secret Rotation Decisions (2026-04-01)
body:
Meeting: Security engineering weekly sync — focused playbook review + decisions on secret rotation cadence
Date: 2026-04-01
Owner (notes): Ava Martinez
Attendees: Ava, Rohan, Sofia, Miguel, Lena, guest: Tom B. (SRE)

Agenda:
- Quick status on active vuln triage queue (what changed since last week)
- Review proposed Secret Rotation Playbook updates (scope: service tokens, DB creds, KMS keys)
- Threat-modeling items for new private-deployment build (on-prem edge cases)
- Confirm runbook changes and canary rotation procedure

Summary / decisions (top-level):
1) Rotation cadence: adopt tiered cadence from playbook draft. Critical service tokens (svc-* admin tokens) => rotate every 7 days automated; DB read-only credentials => 30 days; long-lived infra keys (for Dedicated infra orchestration) => 90 days with quarterly audit. Rationale: balances blast radius vs operational churn; agreed 4-1 vote.

2) Emergency rotation flow: formalize 'partial revocation' step to allow short-lived fallback tokens to be issued before mass revocation for high-impact secrets. Added step to playbook with explicit timeouts and owner escalation matrix.

3) Threat model note: for Private (air-gapped) installs, do not rely on automatic KMS rotations. Add manual step that requires customer approval + signed ticket. Document to include template confirmation email.

Vuln triage highlights (new / moved):
- SEC-1284: prototype GH action token used in deploy pipeline — severity: high. Assigned Rohan. Plan: rotate token, patch GH action to use OIDC short-lived creds. ETA: 2026-04-03. Linked PR: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/754.
- SEC-1290 (medium): dependency golang/x/crypto: update pinned version in runtime builder image. Sofia to open patch. ETA: 2026-04-05.
- Vendor dependency note: telemetry-agent (third-party) shows CVE-2025-3341; mitigation: pinned to safe release and added runtime sandboxing. Miguel to file CSP waiver if vendor slow.

Playbook review (changes proposed and acceptance):
- Add explicit owner fields to each step (new field: 'step_owner') so on-call knows who to contact. Agreed.
- Include 'canary rotation' concept: rotate a single pod/region first, validate telemetry for 15m, then continue. Need SRE buy-in. Action: Tom to add SRE checklist items into playbook and link to canary rollout PR.
- Metric gating: define failure thresholds that abort full rotation (e.g., >5% 500s, anomaly in auth-failure rate). Ava to propose thresholds by next sync.

Runbook / procedure changes (concrete):
- New script: scripts/rotate-secret --dry-run --canary --region. (PR created: infra/pull/754)
- Add 'communication template' for rotation events: short incident-like broadcast + list of dependent services. Template appended to playbook.
- Post-rotation smoke tests: token validation, healthcheck end-to-end, and perf sample for impacted routes (latency/regression).

Threat modeling notes (private-deployments):
- Attack vector: offline credential compromise during on-prem upgrade window. Mitigation: require physical key escrow + manual confirmation step.
- Data-exfil vector via debug endpoints: agreed to tighten access and add stubbed endpoints that return 403 outside diagnostic windows.
- Action: compile a short threat-model appendix for private deployments; Lena to draft and attach to playbook by 2026-04-08.

Open questions / unresolved items:
- How to handle rotations for third-party vendor tokens where vendor does not support programmatic rotation? (Miguel to propose vendor-specific playbook addenda)
- Do we standardize 7-day critical token rotation across all environments (hosted/dedicated/private)? SRE concerns about operational overhead in Dedicated — deferred.
- Should we create a 'rotation budget' metric in Console to show projected churn/cost from rotations? Product input required.

Action items (owners + ETA):
- Rohan: rotate GH deploy token, complete PR to OIDC flow. ETA 2026-04-03.
- Sofia: bump golang/x/crypto in runtime builder; open PR. ETA 2026-04-05.
- Miguel: vendor communication plan for telemetry-agent; draft CSP waiver if needed. ETA 2026-04-07.
- Tom (SRE): add canary checklist and sign off on 'canary rotation' in playbook; attach PR link. ETA 2026-04-04.
- Ava: propose metric gating thresholds and update playbook doc with step_owner fields. ETA 2026-04-06.
- Lena: private-deployment threat-model appendix. ETA 2026-04-08.

Notes to reviewers (informal):
- This doc is a working copy of the playbook review sync. Expect follow-ups and small edits. If you see a missing service in the 'dependent services' table, add it inline or ping me on Slack (#sec-eng).
- We intentionally set a slightly aggressive cadence for critical tokens to reduce blast radius risk; if SRE pushes back, we will scope an operational runbook to minimize human steps.

Relevant links (quick):
- Playbook (draft): https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SEC/pages/987654321/Secret+Rotation+Playbook
- GH PR for rotation tooling: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/754
- Runtime vuln PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/210

Next sync: 2026-04-08 — main focus: review implemented canary checklist and metric thresholds.

End of notes.
